values.prompt: Create a Storyboard continuity Character Sheet for Ada using the universal identity layout. @Reference1 is the sole appearance authority: use its linework, value treatment, finish, lighting behavior, texture, and detail density. @Reference2 is the canonical content authority: preserve Ada's exact identity, face, proportions, simple travel dress, boots, brass hair clip, and relevant state, but do not copy its photographic lighting, finish, or realism. Place one large straight-on face close-up cropped above the shoulders, then compact name, known height, identity synopsis, and brass hair clip detail below it. Follow with complete full-length FRONT, BACK, LEFT PROFILE, and RIGHT PROFILE views in that order, neutral pose, feet visible, consistent proportions and wardrobe. Include a labeled numeric height ruler agreeing with the written 5 ft 6 in / 168 cm height. No gestures, expressions, action poses, environments, tools, swatches, or extra studies.
